phrases.english: 1. Praise belongs to God who was kind to us

phrases.arabic: بِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
phrases.english: 2. through Muhammad, His Prophet (God bless him and his Household)
3. to the exclusion of past communities and bygone generations,

phrases.arabic: بِقُدْرَتِهِ الَّتِي لَا تَعْجِزُ عَنْ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ إِنْ عَظُمَ
phrases.english: 4. displaying thereby His power, which nothing can render incapable though it be great,

phrases.arabic: وَ لا يَفُوتُهَا شَيءٌ وَإنْ لَطُفَ،
phrases.english: 5. and nothing can escape though it be subtle.
6. He sealed through us all He created,

phrases.arabic: وَ جَعَلَنَا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى مَنْ جَحَدَ
phrases.english: 7. appointed us witnesses over those who deny,
8. and increased us by His kindness over those who are few.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ أَمِينِكَ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ
phrases.english: 9. O God, bless Muhammad, entrusted by You with Your revelation,
10. distinguished by You among Your creatures,
11. devoted to You among Your servants,
12. the imam of mercy, the leader of good,
13. the key to blessing,
14. who wearied his soul for Your affairs,
15. exposed his body to detested things for Your sake,
16. showed open enmity toward his next of kin by summoning to You,
17. fought against his family for Your good pleasure,
18. cut the ties of the womb in giving life to Your religion,
19. sent far those close because of their denial,

phrases.arabic: وَ قَرَّبَ الْأَقْصَيْنَ عَلَى اسْتِجَابَتِهِمْ لَكَ
phrases.english: 20. brought near those far because of their response to You,
21. showed friendship to the most distant for Your sake,
22. displayed enmity toward the nearest for Your sake,

phrases.arabic: و أَدْأَبَ نَفْسَهُ فِي تَبْلِيغِ رِسَالَتِكَ
phrases.english: 23. made his soul persevere in delivering Your message,
24. tired it in summoning to Your creed,
25. busied it in counselling those worthy of Your summons,
26. migrated to the land of exile
27. and the place of remoteness from the home of his saddlebags,
28. the walkway of his feet, the ground of his birth,

phrases.arabic: وَمَأْنَسِ نَفْسِهِ إِرَادَةً مِنْهُ لِإِعْزَازِ دِينِكَ
phrases.english: 29. and the intimate abode of his soul, desiring to exalt Your religion
30. and seeking help against those who disbelieved in You,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى ٱسْتَتَبَّ لَهُ مَا حَاوَلَ فِي أَعْدَائِكَ
phrases.english: 31. until what he attempted against Your enemies went well with him

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتَتَمَّ لَهُ مَا دَبَّرَ فِي أَوْلِيآئِكَ
phrases.english: 32. and what he arranged for Your friends was accomplished.
33. He rose up against them seeking victory through Thine aid,
34. becoming strong in spite of his weakness with Your help.
35. He fought against them in the centre of their cities
36. and attacked them in the midst of their dwellings,
37. until Your command prevailed,
38. and Your word rose up, though the idolaters were averse.
39. O God, so raise him, because of his labours for Your sake,
40. to the highest degree of Your Garden,
41. that none may equal him in station,
42. none may match him in level,

phrases.arabic: وَلَا يُوَازِيَهُ لَدَيْكَ مَلَكٌ مُقَرَّبٌ وَلَا نَبِيٌّ مُرْسَلٌ
phrases.english: 43. and no angel brought nigh or prophet sent out may parallel him in Your sight.
44. And inform him concerning his Household the pure
45. and his community the faithful of an excellent intercession,

phrases.arabic: أَجَلَّ مَا وَعَدْتَهُ يَا نَافِذَ الْعِدَةِ
phrases.english: 46. greater than what You hast promised him! O Keeper of promises!

phrases.arabic: يَا وَافِىَ الْقَوْلِ يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ
phrases.english: 47. O Faithful to Your word! O He who changes evil deeds into manifold good deeds!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ الْجَوَادُ اَلْكَرِيمُ
phrases.english: 48. You art of bounty abounding!
